newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow to moderate in the panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 2,400 slaughter steers and 1,800 heifers; 115,900 head confirmed for week to date which includes 13,800 head formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 70.00, north plains 70.50-71.00. Pen select, few choice 2-3 1175 lbs 69.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 70.00, north plains 71.00. Select, few choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 69.00. Pen select and choice 2-3 1100 lb, including heiferettes, 68.00.
Confirmed: 4,200 Week Ago: None Year Ago: 5,800
Wk to date: 115,900 Week Ago: 16,300 Year Ago: 35,100
